messages:
elaine: quick proposal — we need a short playbook for the telemetry gateway when route quotas kick in. goals: deterministic sampling, provenance for debugging, short-lived unmask for SREs, and audit-mode for compliance. thoughts?

raj: +1 on deterministic sampling. prefer per-tenant sample rate computed as hash(customer_id) % 100 < rate_pct so samples are sticky across retries. add per-route override in config.

maria: audit-mode idea: capture full req/res but write to an encrypted audit bucket with KMS and 7-day TTL, accessible only via legal+security workflow. can we make that opt-in per-tenant?

jen: UX Q — how present short-lived unmask in Console? propose an "Inspect" button that opens a temp session (5–30m) with required reason and audit trail. show sample_decision + RBAC check inline.

frank: concern: if we sample deterministically but change hash key or rules we risk split traces. add a provenance_id header set at first touch and include `sample_decision` and `sampler_version` so dashboards can reassemble.

elaine: agree. config sketch for gateway rules:

```json
{
  "routes": [
    {"id": "route-embed","sampling_pct": 1, "sticky_by": "customer_id"},
    {"id": "route-gen","sampling_pct": 5, "sticky_by": "trace_id", "fallback": "minimal-log"}
  ],
  "audit": {"enabled": false, "kms_key": "projects/.../keys/telemetry-audit", "retention_days": 7}
}
```

elaine: playbook bullets: 1) sampling decision at ingress; propagate headers `x-telemetry-sample: yes|no` + `x-telemetry-version: v3`; 2) store only hashed PII in sampled logs by default; 3) Inspect/unmask uses HMAC with per-org keys; 4) audit-mode bypasses masking but writes to encrypted store.

maria: HMAC key rotation — ops/security owns rotation. propose rotation window and tooling to refuse replays older than rotation time unless legal requests reprocessing.

raj: dashboards: show sample_rate by route, sampled vs unsampled QPS, percent of Inspect sessions started, count of audit-access requests and approvals. include sampler_version label to detect regressions.

deploy-bot: canary flag `telemetry_gateway_v3` rolled to staging (5% traffic) — watch `telemetry.sample_decisions` and `audit.access_requests`.

jen: fallback policy: when router downgrades to cost-tier fallback, reduce payload logging to minimal (status, model_id, latency) unless sampled — prevents prompt leakage to cheaper logging sinks.

frank: GDPR: per-tenant `data_residency` flag. EU tenants must store audit blobs in EU region; retention overrides for region.

elaine: rollout: 2-week canary on ~5% global traffic, per-route overrides for high-risk tenants, Console Inspect behind feature flag + RBAC. Post-canary, enable for dev routes; keep enterprise tenants opt-in until legal signs off.

raj: operational: add sampler dry-run mode that logs decision but doesn't drop un-sampled payloads — run for a week to validate distribution and metrics.

maria: tests: unit tests for hash stickiness, e2e test that Inspect session logs audit entry, chaos test where sampler_version flips mid-trace to ensure linking by provenance_id.

elaine: to-dos: (1) draft playbook doc, (2) implement headers + provenance_id, (3) Console Inspect mock + RBAC flow, (4) audit bucket + retention, (5) dashboards + dry-run. volunteers: (1,2)=elaine, (3)=jen, (4)=infra-security, (5)=raj.

frank: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the canary window for next Tue.

jen: :thumbsup:

raj: thumbs up.

maria: approved pending privacy review on retention.

elaine: thanks all — starting doc and will ping for reviews.
